The new route (api_key.py:44-53) authenticates only via `get_current_active_user`, which (auth/utils.py:261-264) merely checks `is_active` and returns the user without any ownership or superuser check. The handler then calls `delete_api_key(db, api_key_id)` with only the user-controlled `api_key_id` and no owner verification, so any active user can delete any other user's API key by supplying its UUID. This is a newly introduced IDOR: the base code prevented it, the PR removes the check.
